title: "survival_curve"
output: html_document

```{r}
library(survival)
library(readr)
z0 <- read_table("/Users/sorenbasnet/Documents/Github/STAT_443_FINAL_PROJECT/data/cna_survival_curve_guide/data_patient_file_cna_rai.txt")
z1 <- read_table("/Users/sorenbasnet/Documents/Github/STAT_443_FINAL_PROJECT/data/cna_survival_curve_guide/fit.txt")

nodenum <- unique(sort(z1$node))
leg.txt <- paste("Node",nodenum)
leg.col <- c("green","magenta","blue","cyan","red")
leg.lty <- rep(c(1,2),c(5,5))
fit <- survfit(Surv(z0$OS_MONTHS,z0$surv_5yrs) ~ z1$node, conf.type="none")
plot(fit,mark.time=FALSE,xlab="Survival time",ylab="Survival probability",
col=leg.col,lwd=2,lty=leg.lty)
title("Kaplan-Meier survival curves")
legend("topright",legend=leg.txt,lty=leg.lty,col=leg.col,lwd=2,ncol=2)
```
